beats.summary: Erin expresses jealousy and hostility toward Andy's girlfriend Jessica, wishing harm on her.

evidence.snippet: Erin: I wish she was in a graveyard! Under the ground…with worms coming out of her mouth.

beats.summary: Andy confronts Erin about her hostile Christmas wish and tells her to get over their past relationship.

evidence.snippet: Erin: Too late! It's already been wished! And you promised it would come true.

beats.summary: Jim discovers a defaced picture of his daughter Cici and suspects Dwight is responsible.

evidence.snippet: Andy: I know who did this…Dwight.

beats.summary: Dwight enthusiastically plays Christmas music loudly, joined by others, as the party continues.

evidence.snippet: Dwight: Enough of this garbage. This is Christmas. Hi-yah!!!!! Yeah!!!! Christmas!!!!
Christmas Eve by Trans-Siberian Orchestra plays. Dwight plays air violin/guitar and sings along

beats.summary: Andy and Jim discuss whether friends can remain friends without a sexual relationship.

evidence.snippet: Andy: Do you think two friends who are not sleeping together can stay friends?
Jim: Two friends who are not sleeping together, can they remain friends? Yes, yeah.

beats.summary: Robert and Erin discuss their broken hearts and Erin seeks advice, but Robert feels unqualified to give love advice.

evidence.snippet: Robert: Your heart is broken. So is mine.
Robert: I've been married thrice and each has ended in an acrimonious divorce, I'm not sure I'm the best person to give love advice

notable_quotes.quote: Erin: It's that I wish Jessica was dead.
notable_quotes.speaker: Erin

Erin: Hey, guys. I just wanted to say. Come here! I'm so happy you guys are together. OK? And you both have such beautiful hair.
[STAGE] Andy and Jessica laugh
Jessica (laughs): Thank you.
Erin: I hope you guys get married…and who knows? Ma
